newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 open weaker after Dow pullback.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 open weaker after Dow pullback.

text.p: The FTSE 100 share index slipped at the open on Thursday, dragged down by a decline in the gilt market and a pullback on Wall Street overnight.
The leading blue chip index, which settled at its intraday record yesterday, was down 15.2 points to 4,342.2.
March gilt futures were down 14/32 to 112-27/32.
The Dow, off 8.5 points when London markets closed, finished 47.33 points lower at 7,020.13 on profit-taking.
"...If Wall Street opens weaker this afternoon, we'll come off a bit," said one dealer.
